name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default but auto-switch to light mode when the system detects high ambient light via the webcam. This keeps visibility high in bright rooms without forcing users to manually toggle, balancing liveliness and clarity. The trade-off is slight complexity in implementation and potential privacy concerns from webcam access.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t ambient light—it’s that auto-switching still assumes users *want* the interface to react to their environment rather than control it themselves. A better alternative is to let users pick a default theme and manually toggle between light/dark, with a persistent indicator showing the current mode. Settle it by testing both: measure how often users override auto-switching in real conditions.
